messages.text: Hi, the running shoes I got are too small. Can I get a refund?

Your order contains the Trail running shoes, but the return records don’t show them received back yet. They must arrive before a refund can be requested (refund-policy/v2/return).

Have you already sent them back, or are you planning to?

messages.text: I’m planning to post them back next Monday.

Thanks for letting me know. The shoes must arrive back at the shop before I can request a refund, so I won’t create a request yet (refund-policy/v2/return).

The refund request must also be created within 30 days of delivery (refund-policy/v2/window).
